title: Random potion effects every 15 seconds
description: This Datapack Gives you Random Potion effects every 15 seconds
body:
Ever wanted Minecraft to be pure chaos?

This datapack gives you a completely random potion effect every 15 seconds!

From insane Speed and Strength boosts to cursed Nausea and Wither, anything can happen. Every 10 seconds, your gameplay flips again — making it perfect for challenges, videos, or just having fun with friends.



⚙️ Features:


⏱️ New random potion effect every 15 seconds

🎯 Includes positive and negative effects

💪 Works in Survival, Hardcore, and Multiplayer

🌍 Compatible with Minecraft 1.19 - 1.19.3

🧩 Lightweight & lag-free — just drop the datapack and /reload



💡 How to Use:

Put the .zip file in your world’s datapacks folder
Run /reload
Boom 💥 — every 15 seconds, a random effect begins!




🎮 Challenge Ideas :


“Can I Beat Minecraft While Getting Random Effects Every 10s?”

“Hardcore, But Every 15 Seconds My Powers Change!”

“My Fate Changes Every 15 Seconds in Minecraft!”
